newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila firm to import 25,000 tonnes of white corn.
newsitem.headline: Manila firm to import 25,000 tonnes of white corn.

text.p: Philippine Agriculture Secretary Salvador Escudero said on Tuesday a local cornstarch manufacturer is set to import 25,000 tonnes of white corn from South Africa.
Escudero told reporters the agriculture department has approved the importation at a 35 percent tariff.
Escudero did not say if the firm had already clinched the deal.

He said he expected the Philippine cornstarch maker to pay a much higher price compared to the $157 per tonne C&F paid by state-agency National Food Authority on its yellow corn importation from China.

Last month, another Philippine Agriculture Department official said NFA signed a contract with Top Glory Trading Co, representative of the National Cereals, Oils and Foodstuffs Import and Export Corp of China, for the import of up to 110,000 tonnes of corn between February 20 and March 25.
